plugins.name: coffee
plugins.description: Keep the Mac awake with caffeinate: say "coffee" to start it, optionally for a set time, and "decaf" to stop it.

plugins.name: docs
plugins.description: Bring a consistent docs/ system to any project: scaffold the layout, add custom doc sections, file plan outcomes under the right doc, and keep statuses honest.

plugins.name: jira
plugins.description: Write Jira that managers and engineers both read: issues with a business-value summary and the business problem before the technical details, and comments that report an investigation as a verdict panel, the facts behind it and the actions — ADF via REST.

plugins.name: language
plugins.description: Write text no reader can misread, in any language: a language-independent take on ASD-STE100 (Simplified Technical English) with trap profiles for English, Russian, Spanish and Estonian and a linter for the mechanical rules.

plugins.name: pr
plugins.description: Both sides of a pull request: shepherd yours to merge — fix failing GitHub Actions, work through every review, rebase when the base runs ahead — merge it the way the repository merges and tidy the local branches after it, and review a colleague's against its Jira task, posting only the problems you pick as one GitHub review.
